candidate.title: Add-guests mutation silently drops blacklisted/already-attending emails yet returns success (and misleading 'emailsmustbeuniquevalid' when all dropped)
candidate.file: unknown (not referenced in the clustered reports and not present in PR #14740 diff; likely the server-side add-guests mutation/handler for bookings/attendees)
reports: success is reported even when some requested guests were silently dropped (blacklisted or duplicates), returning 'guests added' without indicating what was dropped, so the user believes all addresses were added

[advisory] blacklisted emails are silently filtered out of the guest list while the handler still returns success. an operator maintaining blacklistedguestemails gets no signal, and the acting user sees the 'guests added' toast while the blacklisted address was never added — a silent partial application of the requested action.

[advisory] blacklisted guest emails are silently filtered out of the request, and if filtering leaves zero guests the error surfaced is the misleading 'emailsmustbeuniquevalid'. a user who submits one blacklisted address among three sees 'guests added' success and never learns one email was dropped; a user whose entire submission was filtered is told their emails were invalid/duplicate, sending them debugging the wrong problem.

[advisory] the new blacklistedguestemails env var silently drops emails rather than surfacing a validation error, and the filter is undisclosed to the caller. an operator sets the blacklist and an organizer adds a mixed list: some guests are silently not added while the ui shows 'guests added', leaving the organizer with no signal that anyone was excluded; the env var itself has no documentation or schema/typing entry anywhere in the diff.

[advisory] when every submitted guest is filtered out because they are already an attendee or blacklisted, the handler throws badrequest with message 'emailsmustbeuniquevalid', which is false in both cases. a user adding an already-invited colleague (the dialog only checks uniqueness within the current input, not against existing attendees) is told their emails are invalid instead of 'already invited', prompting confused retries with the same result.

[bug] blacklisted guest emails are silently filtered out of uniqueguests with no error, no skipped-list in the response, and no log, while the mutation returns success 'guests added'. a user adding a blacklisted address sees the success toast and believes the guest was invited, but no attendee row is created and no email is sent; when every input is filtered, the error returned is the misleading 'emailsmustbeuniquevalid' even though the addresses are unique and valid.
